title: Your Thoughts Become Text
script: What if thinking a sentence was enough to type it? Clinical research has translated brain signals into speech for people with paralysis. That is not unrestricted mind-reading. It is a carefully trained communication system. Now imagine that interface becoming an everyday way to write a message. Typing gets easier. Keeping the data private becomes a different challenge. If an interface reads the signal, who owns it?
